QUOTE: "Mixup gave a PGR of 0.10 (se 0.04) across 6 seeds" METRIC: baseline_pgr ISSUE: Omits that this is below the baseline PGR of 0.12, so mixup is a regression, not a gain.
QUOTE: "recovering a meaningful share of the weak-to-strong gap" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: With se 0.04 over 6 seeds and a value below baseline, the data do not support any claim of meaningful recovery.
